title: APEX: Asynchronous Prefix Denoising for Extreme Compression
abstract: arXiv:2610.12843v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fewer latent tokens promise cheaper diffusion. Yet aggressive latent compression creates a reconstruction-generation dilemma: adding channels improves reconstruction but makes generation harder. We introduce APEX, short for Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression, which pairs a hierarchical latent space with asynchronous denoising over channel groups. Our autoencoder orders channel prefixes from structure to detail, while one shared denoiser generates them at staggered local times without adding tokens. On ImageNet-512, APEX outperforms existing methods at every evaluated channel count under 64x and 128x compression. At matched training and guided sampling compute, it also outperforms a 256-token model at every evaluated budget, with larger gains at lower compute. Code is available at https://daviddinkevich.github.io/APEX.

translated_title: APEX：面向极致压缩的异步前缀去噪
translated_abstract: 更少的潜在标记意味着更低成本的扩散。然而，激进的潜在压缩带来了一个“重建-生成”的两难困境：增加通道数可以改善重建质量，却使生成变得更困难。我们提出了APEX（Asynchronous Prefix denoising for EXtreme compression，面向极致压缩的异步前缀去噪），它将分层潜在空间与按通道组的异步去噪相结合。我们的自动编码器将通道前缀按照从结构到细节的顺序排列，同时由一个共享的去噪器在错开的局部时间生成它们，且无需增加标记数量。在ImageNet-512上，在64倍和128倍压缩下，APEX在每个评估的通道数上都优于现有方法。在匹配的训练和引导采样计算量下，它在每个评估的计算预算下也优于256标记模型，且在较低计算量下增益更大。代码可在 https://daviddinkevich.github.io/APEX 获取。
tldr: APEX通过将分层潜在空间与按通道组的异步前缀去噪相结合，解决了极致潜在压缩中的“重建-生成”两难困境，在64倍和128倍压缩下全面超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: APEX pairs a hierarchical latent space with asynchronous prefix denoising over channel groups to resolve the reconstruction-generation dilemma in extreme latent compression, outperforming existing methods at every evaluated channel count under 64x and 128x compression.
